mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.chat_audit_record (audit_id, trace_id, tenant_id, domain, endpoint, principal_id, started_at, completed_at, record) VALUES (#{auditId}::uuid, #{traceId}, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{domain}, #{endpoint}, #{principalId}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{recordJson}::jsonb)

INSERT INTO public.chat_audit_unattributed (audit_id, trace_id, started_at, endpoint, http_method, http_status, record) VALUES (#{auditId}::uuid, #{traceId}, #{startedAt}, #{endpoint}, #{httpMethod}, #{httpStatus}, #{recordJson}::jsonb)
